explanation: Job 1 corrupts the upstream provenance handoff by writing each evidence source row's record_id from source_id instead of preserving the need record_id. Job 2 then cannot match evidence ranks to coverage record_ids, so every priority row has upstream_rank 0, violating the requirement to preserve upstream provenance order.
cited_evidence: assemble_provenance appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), ...}, changing record_id from n06-rXX to sXX.
Job 2 input evidence_sources contains record_id values s01 through s08, while needs/coverage record_id values are n06-r01 through n06-r08.
prioritize builds rank_by_record_id from evidence_sources_df record_id and looks up coverage record_id, producing observed upstream_rank: 0 for all priorities.
